doc: Walk into the lake (swim at 1.5 m depth), swim out, turn and swim back, walk out and regenerate; then swim for the deep middle until the wheel is empty, drown and respawn at the shore. Generated by client/src/sim/golden/generate.ts on worldgen.wasm (collision_height, water_height). Replay: start at `initial` (staminaMax in fine units), apply each frame with dt and env, compare to states[i]. Row: [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,airJumps,mode,stamina,timer,lunge,flags]. See client/src/sim/README.md.
